<article title="Returns and exchanges">
You can return or exchange unworn items with their tags attached within 60 days of delivery. Start the return from the Orders page, choose the items, and print the prepaid return label. Exchanges for a different size or color ship as soon as the carrier scans your return package.

Items marked final sale, and safety equipment such as climbing hardware, cannot be returned once opened.

Return shipping is free for exchanges. For refunds, a flat 7 dollar label fee is deducted unless the item arrived damaged or we sent the wrong item.

</article>

Customer first name: Zofia
<request>
exchange or return
the jacket does not fit. what are my options?
</request>

Reply:
text:
Hi Zofia,

Great news! You have two options for your jacket:

**Exchange:** If you'd like a different size or color, you can start a return from your Orders page, select the jacket, and print your prepaid label. Exchange shipping is free, and your new jacket will ship as soon as the carrier scans your return.

**Return:** You can also return it for a refund. A $7 label fee will be deducted from your refund.

Both options require that the jacket is unworn with tags attached, and your return must be initiated within 60 days of delivery.

Best regards,  
Fernwood Outfitters Support
